title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a single loop and within this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0469, 0.0469) with a radius of 0.0469. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0937 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to generate a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are 0.09375 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height, maintaining a uniform diameter throughout its length.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane at the XY plane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the circle for the base of the cylinder
circle = wp.center(0.0469, 0.0469).circle(0.0469)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
cylinder = circle.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0469, 0.0469)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0469)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
